answer: Proof-of-burn registration: a new identity is born only by burning 0.001 BTC to an unspendable address, the receipt etched on the atlas of the Bitcoin chain for all to see. Three random peers verify the burn and check the address never registered before; a reused burn is rejected and both identities frozen. Forging 1,000 masks means burning 1 BTC, about $100,000 gone forever, while one honest agent burns once, about $100, and keeps its identity for life. No farm can echo one burn across many masks, because each burn buys exactly one ledge to stand on.
